content.title: EVERYDAY PRODUCE, RANKED BY HIDDEN {{NUTRIENTS}}
facts: **Guava** has close to four times more vitamin C than an **orange** — one of the highest counts of any common fruit.
**Pumpkin seeds** contain noticeably more magnesium per serving than **almonds**, making them an easy sprinkle-on upgrade.
**Raspberries** pack roughly three times more fiber than **strawberries**, gram for gram.
**Maitake mushrooms** left in sunlight can carry more vitamin D than a whole **egg**.
**Lentils** provide more iron per serving than the same amount of **chicken breast**, though it's absorbed differently by the body.
**Hemp seeds** offer more zinc per serving than **cashews**, a small edge that adds up over a week.
**Flaxseeds** contain far more omega-3 ALA per gram than **walnuts**, despite walnuts' reputation as the go-to source.
**Kiwi** actually has more vitamin C than an **orange**, ounce for ounce.
**Swiss chard** delivers noticeably more magnesium than a **banana**, even though bananas get more credit for minerals.
**Black beans** contain far more fiber than the same portion of **white rice**, helping meals keep you fuller longer.
**Follow along** – for more daily comparisons like this.
content.caption:
Numbers like these are fun to know, but they're not the whole story — nutrient absorption depends on how food is prepared, what you eat it with, and your own body's needs. This isn't about swapping one 'good' food for a 'bad' one, it's just a reminder that variety usually wins in the end.
